description: Deletes the local encrypted state file (JWT, API keys, session key) and forgets the in-memory admin account. Does NOT revoke anything server-side: the sign-in JWT stays valid until it expires unless auth_sign_out_everywhere runs first; revoke API keys with api_keys_revoke first; a smart-account session key stays authorized until it expires or an admin signer calls removeSessionKey.
name: auth_logout
title: Wipe local credentials
